newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chilled kangaroo has lucky escape in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Chilled kangaroo has lucky escape in Belgium.

text.p: A kangaroo that has been on walkabout in woods near Antwerp in Belgium for at least two years had a lucky escape when police and firemen finally tracked down the half-frozen animal and took it to the zoo.

Antwerp zoo spokeswoman Ilse Segers said on Tuesday the Bennetts kangaroo, captured earlier this month, was believed to have been a domestic pet which escaped some years ago, as no kangaroos had been reported missing recently. It had been seen in the area for at least two years, she added.
"It did not want to be caught despite the fact that some parts of its body were frozen," she said by telephone.
